findings.title: Caution overstates when rolling-updates feature is required
findings.body: The caution says the Operator will fail unless `rolling-updates` is enabled. The updated UpgradeTest only adds the feature to the CR for explicit `spec.update.strategy` values; for the default (`strategy == null`) it returns before enabling the feature and still expects successful rolling/recreate behavior in `testImageChange[null]` and `testCacheMaxCount[null]`. Either the requirement only applies when `spec.update` is set and the caution should say so, or those tests are missing the required feature and are not exercising the documented gate.

findings.title: testMissingOptionOnSave can pass when feature gate exits early
findings.body: The test only asserts that `Missing required argument` is absent. With the new feature check in `UpdateCompatibilityMetadata.run()`, a run where `--features=rolling-updates` is not recognized exits with the feature-disabled error before option validation, and this assertion still passes. The test should assert that the metadata command actually ran, for example no feature-disabled error, exit code 0, or metadata output, otherwise it no longer verifies that `--file` is optional.

findings.title: Documented exit codes 3 and 4 are not asserted
findings.body: The new documented contract has exit code 4 for feature-disabled and changes recreate from 4 to 3. `testFeatureNotEnabled` only checks the error text, and `testWrongVersions` only checks the incompatibility message; neither asserts the exit code. A regression that prints the right text but returns the wrong code would go unnoticed, despite the exit code being the scriptable contract described in `update-compatibility.adoc`.
